instruction.description: Save a subtree to file, creating parent directories as needed. Uses the same serialization formats as schema.

file.description: output file (default: <node name>.<format>; unnamed node: root.<format>); supports ~/; creates parent directories

path.description: node path (default: session current node or root; required without session); relative to current node, / starts at root

format.description: schema format: explicit > file extension > json

path.description: exported node path relative to session or global root

instruction.description: Load a file into a subtree, creating missing target nodes. Uses the same defaults and serialization formats as save.

file.description: input file (default: <node name>.<format>; unnamed node: root.<format>); supports ~/

path.description: target node path, created if absent (default: session current node or root; required without session); relative to current node, / starts at root

format.description: schema format: explicit > file extension > json

path.description: imported node path relative to session or global root

instruction.description: Locate nodes under root by matching key or value. AI-friendly: default mode is substring 'contains' (case-insensitive). Use mode='glob' for */? wildcards or mode='exact' for strict equality. Returns matching paths, stops after 'top' hits.

pattern.description: match string; interpretation depends on mode

root.description: subtree root path; defaults to session root

matches.description: paths relative to root, DFS insertion order
